seo.metaDescription: How eCom Gliders collects, uses, and protects personal and business information when you visit our website or use our Amazon agency services.

intro: At eCom Gliders, your privacy matters. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website, use our services, or interact with our team.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
paragraphs: We may collect the following types of information:
bullets: Personal information: name, email address, phone number, billing address, and other details you voluntarily provide when contacting us or signing up for services.
Business information: Amazon seller account details, store name, ASINs, advertising data, product listings, and performance metrics you share with us.
Technical information: IP address, browser type, device details, referral sources, and browsing behavior on our website.
Payment information: for invoicing and processing payments, we may collect billing details. We do not store credit card numbers; payments are handled through secure third-party processors (Stripe).

sections.heading: 2. How we use your information
bullets: Provide and manage our Amazon agency services
Communicate with you about your account or inquiries
Improve our website, services, and client experience
Analyze data to optimize your Amazon performance
Send important updates, newsletters, or marketing (you can opt out at any time)

sections.heading: 3. Information sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal or business data. We only share your information in the following cases:
bullets: With trusted third-party tools and partners who help us provide our services (for example analytics platforms, advertising tools, and invoicing software)
When required by law, court order, or to protect our legal rights

sections.heading: 4. Data security
paragraphs: We take data protection seriously. Your information is stored securely and protected using industry-standard security measures. While no online system is fully secure, we work to safeguard your data against unauthorized access, misuse, or loss.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights
bullets: Access the personal data we hold about you
Request correction or deletion of your data
Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time
Ask us to stop processing your data (subject to legal or contractual obligations)

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance user experience and analyze website traffic. You can adjust your browser settings to refuse cookies, but this may affect site functionality.

sections.heading: 7. Third-party links
paragraphs: Our site may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites. Please review their privacy policies before submitting any data.

sections.heading: 8. Updates to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

sections.heading: 9. Contact us
paragraphs: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, contact us using the details below.
